runBearer.description: Short-lived run/attempt/epoch-scoped token. Cannot read hidden worlds, provider secrets or evaluator results.

workspaceBearer.description: Verified current workspace service identity; human browser access uses sessionCookie where explicitly allowed.

info.description: Planning contract, not an implemented endpoint or complete platform API. First subset: create/read/cancel runs, public observations, checkpoints, model receipts and event resume. Workspace identity/management, world/package upload, provider calls, exports, audit, SSO and SCIM require separate reviewed contracts in SP-01 and their work packages.
info.title: Strange Physics proposed run lifecycle API

put.description: Immutable per workspace/run/index. Body index equals path. New index exceeds latest checkpoint and may lag the contiguous committed observation prefix, including failed physics records. Exact historical full-payload replay returns its prior result without moving latest. Changed payload conflicts. ART payload remains draft.

Retry-After.description: Delay or retry time; does not override a depleted budget.

get.description: Lists accepted-slot operations in ordinal order, including pending and aborted slots. Completed physics failures carry ExperimentRecord. Missing observations stop the contiguous prefix; never skip or synthesize them.

Retry-After.description: Delay or retry time; does not override a depleted budget.

post.description: Validate and authorize, resolve scoped idempotency, then atomically reserve ordinal/debit/outbox. Fresh admission cannot bypass an unobserved accepted slot. Retry a recoverable operation at the same index/request/debit/regime identity; unrecoverable gaps terminate the run. Physical simulation failure completes this operation with a failed ExperimentRecord.

post.description: Asynchronous cancellation. Reauthorize before deduplication. Atomically revoke launch/broker/result/checkpoint authority and enter cancelling; terminal cancelled requires worker termination and reservation reconciliation. Accepted experiment slots are never refunded. Queued runs without work may become cancelled directly. Terminal runs reject new cancellations; exact authorized retries return the original operation. Only results committed before cancellation acceptance survive; later worker output is rejected even before settlement.
